question: Within a 30 kilometers distance, where can I find a restaurant on the path toward Sin Titulo, San Francisco, CA from Golden Gate Bridge Lookout, Sausalito, CA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.486003 37.82872)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.407407 37.789485)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.486003 37.82872)',4326)::geography, 30000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.486003 37.82872)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
